items.source: DefaultChatClient uses this marker to detect whether a memory advisor is already present in the chain, and to avoid auto-registering a duplicate when memory management is configured on the ChatClient.
items.translation: DefaultChatClient 使用该标记来检测内存顾问是否已存在于链中，并在ChatClient上配置了内存管理时避免自动注册重复项。

items.source:
Marker interface for advisors that own the memory lifecycle. An advisor implementing
this interface takes responsibility for managing the chat memory, including storing,
retrieving, and updating conversation context.
items.translation: 拥有内存生命周期的顾问的标记接口。实现此接口的顾问负责管理聊天内存，包括存储、检索和更新对话上下文。
